character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
A lean ninja warrior, dark realistic 16-bit Sega Genesis pixel art style. Dark navy blue fitted suit with subtle
  ▎ folds, red headband with two long tails flowing behind, dark cloth mask covering the lower face, only the eyes
  ▎ visible, katana in a dark scabbard strapped diagonally across his back with the grip sticking out above his right
  ▎ shoulder, light bronze armour plates on forearms and shins, red belt, wrapped dark boots. Warm dusk lighting from
  ▎ lower left, crisp 1-pixel dark outline, limited palette of about 15 colours, no anti-aliasing.
